title: Kamishiro Rui — Tengu Swordsmanship〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Mikazukigumi Practice Area

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Unsheathe your katana here and attack.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Turn around, look at the person behind you and parry their attack.)

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line: Good. Your movements look much sharper!

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line:
But your katana looked light...
It didn't seem to weigh anything, you know?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It looked light...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I see... As Kurama Tengu, I thought I was supposed to be as light as possible on my feet as I moved around, but...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Fleet footwork isn't all he has.
He also possesses monstrous strength, which allows him to swing around a heavy sword with ease.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'd forgotten that he isn't actually human. I failed to capture that part of him just now.

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line:
...!
Yes, that's exactly what I wanted to say!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (However, a bamboo sword weighs but a fraction of a real one. I can act all I want, but I'm not sure I'll be able to make it look heavy...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (So, how do I go about this problem...?)

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Kamishiro...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry.
I was just wondering how I'm going to make my katana feel heavy.

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line:
Right...
I guess the best solution is to hold a real one.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
A real one...
But actually finding one sounds a bit difficult.

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line: I happen to know someone at a shop that sells swords. Want me to ask them? They might be willing to help you out.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Really? Yes, please.

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line:
Alright, I'll try asking them.
Should I tell them that all four of you are going?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, that would be incredibly helpful.
And thank you for going out of your way to do this.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I can't believe they're willing to do so much for us.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Still, if I'm learning about katanas, I don't want to stop at just holding one...)
A few days later
Rui's Room

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Seeing all those real katanas with Tsukasa and the others was such a wonderful learning experience.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (We got to try holding all types, large and small. They even let us equip some in order to see how heavy they felt at our waist.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And I really wasn't expecting them to show us the tang underneath where the handle would go.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Anyway...
I was able to get the lumber I wanted at the store...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, let's start making that practice sword.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(I got to see quite a lot today.
And making my own sword should help deepen my understanding of the subject.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It's unfortunate that I can't make a real one here since that would be the best solution...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But making a wooden one should help further solidify what I saw today in my mind.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Not to mention this is my very first time crafting one from scratch. This is all very exciting.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now, which part should I work on first?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Why don't I begin with the blade?
That should be the easiest place to start.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I'll mark where I need to cut with my pen and saw accordingly...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Next, the tip... I'll need to carefully shave a round corner off the edge here.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Phew...
It's beginning to look like a real katana now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The surface is still a little rough, but I can deal with that later by sanding it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Still, it feels much thicker than the ones we saw today. I think I'll make it thinner and...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, it feels about as thin as a real one. But it appears it would be weak to strikes from the side...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Which means I won't want to parry attacks the same way I did during practice the other day.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Also, where I place this katana's center of gravity will likely change how I'm able to wield it.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The closer it is to my hand, the easier it will be to swing around, but at the cost of power. On the other hand, the closer it is to the tip, the heavier it'll seem.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Still, Kurama Tengu would probably have no problem swinging around such a weapon...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I'm glad I'm doing this. I'm learning so much.)
A few days later

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Mikazukigumi Practice Area

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Unsheathe, then...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Turn around. You'll see one of the Taira henchmen trying to take a chop at you and...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(Parry while also trying to dodge!
Taking that attack head-on would mean damaging your katana.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (This katana's center of gravity sits at the tip, so it wobbling this much is normal when parrying an attack...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(But I'm Kurama Tengu.
I should be able to swing a blade like this as easily as breathing.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Step, flex your wrist muscles and slice!)

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line:
That was awesome, Kamishiro...!
The way you moved just now was so realistic.

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line: Yeah! I guess you've gotten a better understanding of how Kurama Tengu's supposed to fight.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line:
Still, I can't believe it.
You've improved so much in such a short amount of time.

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line: Did you guys actually go check out some real katanas at that shop we talked about the other day?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, we did. That ended up being an invaluable experience for us. Thank you for introducing us to them.

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line:
No, don't worry about that.
All I did was make one phone call.

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line: In any case, this scene's gonna feel so different now. Is this all really because of that one visit?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, not quite... Actually holding real katanas did help, but I also ended up making a wooden one for practice afterwards.

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line: A wooden one?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. I thought actually making one myself would help me achieve a better understanding of swords as opposed to just seeing and feeling some.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And it helped quite a lot. Now I know that the broadside of a katana is very brittle, as well as how they were designed to cut while being unsheathed.

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line:
Wow, that's how you learned?
It's a unique approach, but I kinda like it.

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line: It's great that you have your own methodology! I think we're all looking forward to how the final product turns out.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I appreciate you saying that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (My own methodology, eh...?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The thought of making my own katana just sort of popped into my head, but I'm glad that I was able to apply everything that I've learned until now.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And I should use this momentum I've built up to become a better swordfighter.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I still have a number of ideas as to how I can wield a katana more like Kurama Tengu.)
